summary: Two facts are re-proved inline many times instead of being stated as lemmas: that the Riesz operator of the pulled-back form is self-adjoint and invertible (six copies), and that pullbacks to the Euclidean model stay nondegenerate and positive (three copies, after the PR deletes the `hpull` helper). `inner_pos_left` also relies on a brittle `field_simp`/`nlinarith` quadratic argument.
